'''Lazar Hayward''' (born on November 26, 1986, in [[Buffalo, New York]]) is a college basketball player for the [[Marquette Golden Eagles]]. He is currently a senior on the 2009-2010 roster.

==High School career==
Hayward attended [[Notre Dame Preparatory School (Fitchburg, Massachusetts)|Notre Dame Prep School]] in [[Fitchburg, Massachusetts]], and while he attended he played with many other notable players, like [[Michael Beasley]] (currently playing for the [[Miami Heat]]), [[Syracuse University]] standout [[Paul Harris (basketball)|Paul Harris]] and current [[UTEP]] player [[Derrick Caracter]].

==College career==
Hayward started both freshman and sophomore seasons.Lazar always wears a backwards [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] headband matching his uniform. Hayward was named one of the top 25 wings in the nation coming out of high school.  Although he starts at [[Power forward (basketball)|Power Forward]] for Marquette, Hayward has always been a great shooter from 3-point range. As of January 30, 2010 Lazar's nickname is Money Man. Still dating high school sweetheart Alyssa Syms, also from Buffalo, NY.
